title: Diamond tread plate
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of diamond tread plate (checker plate): elongated raised lugs in alternating diagonals, polished lug tops, dirt in the valleys and paint worn through to bare metal. Use for floors, steps, ramps, truck beds and industrial props.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python diamond_plate.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: lugs_across
parameters.meaning: Lug cells across the tile (and down it).

parameters.name: lug_length
parameters.meaning: Lug length as a share of the cell diagonal.

parameters.name: lug_width
parameters.meaning: Lug width as a share of the cell.

parameters.name: wear
parameters.meaning: Polish of the lug tops (and paint worn through on painted plate).

parameters.name: paint
parameters.meaning: Paint coverage (0 bare metal, 1 fully painted plate).

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: steel_dirty
presets.description: Dark steel tread plate with dirt in the valleys.

presets.name: painted_yellow
presets.description: Yellow painted tread plate worn to metal on the lug tops.

presets.name: fine_pattern
presets.description: Fine-pitched bright plate with short lugs.

limits: Lugs are identical capsules on a regular grid; real plates differ in lug shape by standard and maker. Wear follows lug height and noise, not walking paths. The lug relief is large for a normal map alone, so parallax or displacement helps at close range. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Capsule distance fields on a checkerboard of +45 and -45 degree cells
Dome profile from the capsule distance
glTF metallic-roughness split between paint and bare metal
